probes.question: In 1965, Gordon Moore noted the number of components per integrated circuit had been doubling every...
True or false: Moore's law is a law of physics.

image.alt: Scatter chart on a logarithmic axis showing microchip transistor counts rising steadily from 1971 to 2019.

body.question: In 1965 Gordon Moore noted that the number of components per chip had been doubling every year. In 1975 he revised his forecast. How often did he then expect the doubling?
body.reveal: In 1975 he revised it to a doubling every two years. Moore later described his 1965 prediction as a wild extrapolation. It is an observation about industry growth, not a law of physics, and it became known as a law because it kept holding.
